conclusive_exclusion_predicate: validity window entirely outside the assessment time scope, OR a declared subject/variable anchor or instrument differing exactly from the claim's; null, partial or missing => pending

indicator_fidelity.proposition: The bound heater indicator implements the ct.procedure.T2.v1 rule for the bound target.

observation_error_bound.phases_note: governs selection (plan capture) and reassessment (interpretation); owner choice O3 may restrict to reassessment
observation_error_bound.proposition: Each T1 reading of the bound instrument lies within the bound half-width of its measurand over the assessment time scope (CONTRACT §4.2) (random reading error; distinct from systematic b_ref).

reference_calibration.proposition: The T1 reference instrument's systematic bias lies within the bound b_ref interval over the assessment time scope (CONTRACT §4.2).

reference_mapping.proposition: The T1 reference instrument observes the bound subject entity and variable anchor under the bound structural model revision.

state_hold.proposition: T_true and b_suspect are unchanged from the bound baseline as-of over the assessment time scope (CONTRACT §4.2), for the bound per-hypothesis b_suspect intervals.
